title: Missing work
summary: Source Editor dev6 candidate has wired oorexx_atomic_file for backup/live publication, but independent qualification is pending. Remaining priority work is argv-correct CLI parsing, references/impact navigation, guarded ProposedChange/patch operations, direct ooRexx CLI UI binding, a Development Desk read/materialise adapter, and native NewShell worker/client/runtime integration.
tasks: Complete independent r13196/native-provider qualification of the dev6 Atomic File integration (Rasen Falcon REQ-00000589), then seal/package only on PASS.
Argv-correct CLI parsing for multi-word literals and regexes.
References, callers/callees and impact navigation over language scanners.
Guarded ProposedChange/patch object with base identity/hash precondition.
Direct ooRexx CLI UI binding to SourceDocument and SourceCompletionProvider.
Read/materialise adapter boundary for Development Desk / Semantic Source Store.
Integrate Source Editor capability into the native NewShell worker/client/runtime surface rather than maintaining a side CLI only.
